current_profile_snapshot.phrase_behavior: dense 4/8-bar lines with pickups, enclosures, turnarounds and rapid phrase release
current_profile_snapshot.harmony_behavior: fast-moving extended harmony, ii-V chains, secondary dominants, substitutions and chromatic approaches
current_profile_snapshot.bass_behavior: continuous walking bass with chord-tone targets and passing approaches
current_profile_snapshot.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: ride + hi-hat support; drums comp interactively rather than fixed backbeat
current_profile_snapshot.instrument_role_behavior: small combo: sax/trumpet/clarinet, piano/guitar, bass, drums
current_profile_snapshot.ensemble_player_behavior: high interaction; accompaniment leaves harmonic information without crowding solo line
current_profile_snapshot.arrangement_transformation: head-solos-head baseline with compact ensemble statements
current_profile_snapshot.dynamic_behavior: accent-driven line shaping rather than large sustained swells
current_profile_snapshot.articulation_behavior: clean fast tonguing/legato alternation, ghosted notes and rhythmic accents as target permits
current_profile_snapshot.timing_humanization_behavior: swing microtiming tightens at faster tempos; ensemble relational timing only
current_profile_snapshot.continuous_performance_control: articulation and accent control prioritized over heavy effects
current_profile_snapshot.mix_prominence_intent: melody and bass clarity prioritized over dense pads
current_profile_snapshot.production_mastering_intent: fast transients, controlled cymbals and headroom
current_profile_snapshot.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires fast articulation-capable lead and rhythm voices
